xml.title: Illinois General Assembly - Bill Status for HB 5256

sponsor.sponsors: Rep. Justin Slaughter-Jed Davis, Lisa Davis, Barbara Hernandez, Will Guzzardi, Kelly M. Cassidy, Theresa Mah, Anne Stava, Michael Crawford, Kevin John Olickal and Curtis J. Tarver, II

synopsis.SynopsisText: Amends the Unified Code of Corrections. Provides that a person who is serving a term of mandatory supervised release shall receive one day of additional supervision credit for each day of his or her mandatory supervised release term. Provides that each day of supervision credit shall reduce by one day the person's period of mandatory supervised release. Provides that if prior to expiration or termination of the term of mandatory supervised release, a person violates a condition set by the Prisoner Review Board or a condition of mandatory supervised release to govern that term, the Board may extend the term of mandatory supervised release by revoking supervision credit earned.
